files.description: Primary EHI export documentation for 170.315(b)(10). Only 3 pages; substantive content is a single page stating that export uses C-CDA XML (USCDI v1) and FHIR R4 Bulk Data (US Core STU 3.1.1). No data dictionary, no export instructions, no field definitions.

118-page SMART on FHIR API guide (v1.0.0.3, updated Nov 2025). This is the (g)(10) API documentation referenced by the EHI export PDF. Covers OAuth2 authentication, FHIR endpoints, and API request/response examples for 26 US Core resource types. Not a (b)(10) document per se, but referenced as part of the EHI export mechanism.

FHIR R4 CapabilityStatement from the production FHIR server. Confirms 26 resource types with US Core profiles. Server identifies as 'Inferno Reference Server for US Core, Bulk Data, and SMART App Launch' based on HAPI FHIR.

FHIR Bundle of Endpoint and Organization resources listing all practices/tenants with FHIR service URLs. Linked from the certification page as 'FHIR Service URLs'. Shows multi-tenant architecture with tenant-specific FHIR endpoints.

SMART on FHIR well-known configuration from the FHIR server. Documents OAuth2 endpoints, supported capabilities (launch-ehr, launch-standalone, client-public, client-confidential-asymmetric/symmetric, backend services), and supported grant types.
Screenshot of the top viewport of the ONC certification page showing product info and certification IDs.

Full-page screenshot of the complete ONC certification page showing all sections: vendor info, product versions, cost links, real world test plans/results, EHI export link, MFA link, SmartOnFHIR API link, FHIR service URLs, and SVAP documents.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the FHIR CapabilityStatement, SMART config, and endpoints bundle into a unified queryable JSON summary.
Enrichment output: queryable JSON with FHIR resource types (26), tenant organizations (107), coverage assessment, and export format documentation.
Enrichment README with run commands, input boundary, output files, and known limitations.
